name: Thing

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Protection: Tüm kaynaklardan alınan hasarı belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Koruma sayesinde çok dayanıklı, 15+ taş biriktirince durdurulamaz olur. Savunma yeteneğini azaltan şampiyon en iyi kontrol. Fiziksel hasarı sınırladığı için ikincil hasarlı şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
Unbreakable Spirit
Thing activates Protection for the next 5 second(s), reducing all damage by [20 - 80]%, plus +1% for each Rock Stack.
Once this ability finishes, it goes into cooldown and cannot be reactivated for 20 seconds.
Unbreakable Spirit will also trigger when Thing is Stunned.
Unbreakable Spirit will also trigger when the Opponent would deal 300% or more of their Attack Rating with a Basic Attack, or 300% or more of their Attack Rating with a Special Attack Hit. This trigger ignores the ability cooldown.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Şok Bağışıklığı ⚡️
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı 🔮
• Zırh Kırma Bağışıklığı 🛡️

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Immune to Bleed, Shock, Armor Break, Armor Shattered, Nullify, Stagger, and Fate Seal effects.
Generate 1 Rock Stack when Struck.
Generate 1 Rock Stack when Blocking a Hit.
Generate 4 additional Rock Stacks with a Well-Timed Block.
Thing removes 3 Rock Stack(s) when he would receive a Bleed. This can't occur more than once every 2 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Passive - Rock Stack
content: Rock Stacks last indefinitely, up to 15 Stacks. Any additional Rock Stacks last for 5 seconds. Rock Stacks are capped at 20.
For each Rock Stack, Physical and Energy Resistance is increased by +[175.53].
Whenever a Rock Stack is removed or the duration expires, Thing gains a permanent Passive Fury, granting +[319.71] Attack. These Fury effects are capped at 60.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: When Thing is Hit and he has 15 or more Rock Stacks, he becomes Unstoppable for 5 second(s) and removes 3 Rock Stack(s) instead of generating any.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: For the next 8 second(s), Thing's attacks Nullify all Unstoppable buffs when striking the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: For each Rock Stack, Damage increased by +[532.85].
If Thing has 15 or more Rock Stacks, he removes all Rock Stacks and this attack is Unblockable.
If Thing has 20 Rock Stacks, inflict Weakness decreasing the Opponent's Attack by 70% for 6 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Stagger the opponent, preventing them from gaining their next Buff for 6 seconds.
If Thing has 15 or more Rock Stacks, he removes all Rock Stacks and this attack is Unblockable.
If Thing has 20 Rock Stacks, Stun the Opponent for 4.5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Thing is Unblockable and Unstoppable for 8 second(s).
If Thing has 15 or more Rock Stacks, he removes all Rock Stacks and he gains a Passive Fury for 8 second(s), increasing his Attack by +[4,262.8].
If Thing has 20 Rock Stacks, his Furies from removing Rock Stacks and from this attack are +100% stronger for 8 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Unbreakable Spirit
content: Thing activates Protection for the next 5 second(s), reducing all damage by [20 - 80]%, plus +1% for each Rock Stack.
Once this ability finishes, it goes into cooldown and cannot be reactivated for 20 seconds.
Unbreakable Spirit will also trigger when Thing is Stunned.

Unbreakable Spirit will also trigger when the Opponent would deal 300% or more of their Attack Rating with a Basic Attack, or 300% or more of their Attack Rating with a Special Attack Hit. This trigger ignores the ability cooldown.
